Oosterman Head Certification Board NMi Certin B.V. Hugo de Grootplein 1 3314 EG Dordrecht the Netherlands T +31 78 6332332 certin@nmi.nl www.nmi.nl This document is issued under the provision that no liability is accepted and that the applicant shall indemnify third-party liability. The notification of NMi Certin B.V. as Issuing Authority can be verified at www.oiml.org OIML RvA INSPECTION RvA 1122 101 --- NMi # OIML Certificate of Conformity **OIML Member State** The Netherlands Number R60/2000-NL1-17.14 Project number 1900650 Page 2 of 2 The conformity was established by the results of tests and examinations provided in the associated OIML Test Report(s): - No. R60/2000-NL1-03.28A dated 1 December 2003 that includes 39 pages; - No. R60/2000-NL1-03.28B dated 1 December 2003 that includes 41 pages. **Characteristics of the load cell:**
Maximum capacity (Emax)300 g up to and including 4,5 kg
Minimum dead load0 kg
Accuracy ClassC
Rated Output0,9 ± 0,1 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n)3000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / vmin6000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR)3000
Input impedance415 Ω ± 25 Ω
Temperature range-10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC0,7
Humidity ClassSH
Safe overload200 % of Emax
Output impedance350 Ω ± 5 Ω
Recommended excitation10 V AC / DC
Excitation maximum15V AC / DC
Transducer materialAlloy Aluminum
Atmospheric protectionButyle rubber
The characteristics for nmax and Y can be reduced separately. Each produced load cell is provided with an accompanying document with information about its characteristics. 101
